title: Summary stays free of sensitive details and nothing else changes

findings.suggested_fix: Split S-5 into a privacy story (AC1, AC2) and a no-regression story (AC3 to AC5), or record in resolves why it stays one story.
findings.text: Previous F-2 is still open: S-5 bundles two independent outcomes, no sensitive details in the summary (REQ-13) and no change anywhere else (REQ-14). The resolves list mentions only F-1.

cites.quote: more appointments than the patient page's Appointments table loads
the patient page's appointment list is loaded with a row limit

findings.suggested_fix: Cite the row limit from the product code and state the count inline, for example limit + 1 appointments.
findings.text: Previous F-3 is still open: S-2 AC2 depends on the Appointments table's row limit but does not name it, so a tester must look up the limit before building the test data.

cites.quote: then each looks and behaves as before and shows no Visit summary

findings.suggested_fix: State the observable check, for example: no 'Visit summary' text appears and the existing regression tests for these pages still pass.
findings.text: Previous F-4 is still open: S-5 AC5 says 'looks and behaves as before' across five pages and names no check a tester can observe.

cites.quote: 1 Scheduled appointment whose start time has already passed and that staff have not closed yet
Scheduled appointments that start after now

findings.suggested_fix: Have the past Scheduled appointment in S-1 AC3 start earlier today, for example one hour before now, so a date-only comparison fails.
findings.text: Previous F-5 is still open: S-1 AC3 does not say when the past Scheduled appointment started. If it is on an earlier day, an upcoming count that compares dates (start date >= today) still passes AC3 and AC4, though REQ-5 compares against now.

rubric_items.reason: All 14 known REQs are traced: REQ-1..5,7 in S-1, REQ-6 in S-2, REQ-8..11 in S-3, REQ-12 in S-4, REQ-13..14 in S-5. The intent has no assumed REQs.
S-1 to S-4 each deliver one outcome. S-5 still bundles the privacy constraint (REQ-13) with the no-regression constraint (REQ-14).

Previous F-1 is fixed: S-3 AC4 now tells the most recent Completed appointment apart from an older Completed, a later No-show and the first table row. S-1 AC3 still misses a same-day past Scheduled case, and S-5 AC5 is not observable.
Values come from the intent, A-01 to A-03 and the glossary. The UTC+05:30 shift is derived inline from C1. Dates and counts are test data, not invented limits.
Terms are clear and match the glossary. S-5 AC5 still says 'looks and behaves as before', and S-2 AC2 leaves the table's row limit unnamed.
